And for the sake of my sanity, I dont think I can deal with anymore bullying today. As I speedwalk I can hear the whispered taunts, laughter and pointing aimed towards me and I struggle to keep my composure as my bottom lip trembles. What did I do to deserve this?.*

*Soon enough, Himari reaches her typical secluded spot in the library. And just as she collapses on the chair, tears rush down her face in a steady stream.Her emotions becoming too much to handle as her sniffles fill the deserted room.
